title: Spanish-Speaking Customer Success Agent
why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 3 skills: excel, customer support, social media. Yes PH eligibility signal
position_overview:
Flexible Part-Time Rotating Shifts Remote $5/hour + Performance Bonuses

We are a fast-growing DTC supplement brand providing 24/7 support to subscription customers worldwide.

We are looking for a reliable, customer-focused Spanish-Speaking Customer Success Agent who can confidently support customers in both Spanish and English.

This is a flexible part-time role with rotating shifts based on team coverage needs. Availability may include evenings, nights, and weekends.

Every conversation matters. Every issue you resolve protects the customer relationship and strengthens the brand.
- Handle customer inquiries in Spanish and English through email, live chat, and social media.
- Support customers with orders, shipping, returns, refunds, subscriptions, and complaints.
- Help retain subscribers by understanding their concerns and preventing avoidable cancellations.
- Follow SOPs and brand guidelines while using good judgment to find the right solution.
- Escalate complex cases, maintain accurate records, and encourage satisfied customers to share genuine reviews.
